overall_summary: Deduplicated analysis of the latest observations reveals that space and planetary 'What If' scenarios (specifically extreme exoplanets and cosmic phenomena like diamond/burning ice/dark planets) dominate both view counts and audience engagement (likes-per-view). Videos focusing on theoretical destruction, extreme planetary environments (e.g., IYuce8vaU3Y, A9Qa-RmuOr0, 8KEl0_pJ_68), and bizarre comparative scales outperform standard psychological tricks or historical mysteries in this dataset window. Recent uploads published late September show superior velocity compared to older September clips.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) generated 1,028 views with 38 likes, and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) reached 980 views with 21 likes shortly after release.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-stakes, immersive planetary 'What If' hooks that force the viewer to visualize extreme physical sensations in space.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring ultra-rare celestial objects or paradoxes like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) drove over 700 to 1,000+ views rapidly.
winning_patterns.action: Maintain high-impact adjectives (supersonic, darker than coal, burning ice) paired with colorful emojis in the title and hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on internal brain quirks or memory tricks (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' with video_id 2fqaGqfsR4A or r43-7nSn8SQ) stalled out under 15 views and zero likes.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract psychological micro-facts unless they involve shocking, visceral survival or extreme biological anomalies.

weak_patterns.pattern: Stale General Space Facts Without Actionable Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Generic statements like 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' plateaued quickly in later uploads compared to interactive hypothetical drops.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive space trivia; frame every cosmic fact as an active environmental threat or mind-bending paradox.
